# Overview

```{=html}
<div id="trm-structure-summary" class="trm-structure-cards"></div>
<div class="trm-structure-note">
Components are coordinate-supported hypotheses. “Composite candidate” and
“nested candidate” are not confirmed biological structures until reads or an
assembled insertion sequence demonstrate linkage between components.
</div>
```

# Structure landscape

Every insertion sequence is visible below as a structure map. The default
ordering brings multi-component and alternative-rich signals to the top, but
does not hide unresolved sequences or sequences without a TE match. Filters
only narrow this landscape when a specific question needs to be tested.

```{=html}
<div class="trm-structure-toolbar">
  <label>Chromosome <select id="trm-structure-chrom"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
  <label>TE family <select id="trm-structure-te"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
  <label>Classification <select id="trm-structure-class"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
  <label>Final call <select id="trm-structure-final"><option value="">All</option><option value="yes">Reported only</option><option value="no">Unreported only</option></select></label>
  <label>Minimum components <input id="trm-structure-min-components" type="number" min="0" value="0"></label>
  <label>Search <input id="trm-structure-search" type="search" placeholder="event, TE, location…"></label>
  <label>Order <select id="trm-structure-sort"><option value="signal">Most informative first</option><option value="position">Genomic position</option><option value="components">Most components</option><option value="length">Longest insertion</option></select></label>
</div>
<div class="trm-structure-toolbar-footer">
  <strong id="trm-structure-filter-note"></strong>
  <button id="trm-structure-reset" type="button" class="trm-structure-button">Reset filters</button>
</div>
<div class="trm-structure-legend" aria-label="Structure map legend">
  <span><i class="trm-legend-retained"></i>Provisional component</span>
  <span><i class="trm-legend-rejected"></i>Rejected candidate shown when no component remains</span>
  <span>Click <strong>Evidence details</strong> for normalized matches and raw HSPs.</span>
</div>
<div id="trm-structure-gallery" class="trm-structure-gallery" role="list"></div>
<p id="trm-structure-empty" class="trm-structure-empty" hidden>No structure matches the current filters.</p>
```

## Cross-sequence event support

This secondary view aggregates all insertion sequences supporting the same
event. It highlights patterns observed on one or several sequences. Selecting
an event focuses the structure landscape above instead of opening a detached
plot elsewhere on the page.

```{=html}
<div class="trm-structure-table-wrap trm-event-table-wrap">
  <table class="trm-structure-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Location</th><th>Event</th><th>Reported TE</th><th>Query sequences</th><th>Queries with components</th><th>Multi-component queries</th><th>Multi-family queries</th><th>Maximum components</th><th>Interpretation</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="trm-event-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

# Interpretation and thresholds

The report retains every raw HSP in `insertion-hsps.tsv`. Thresholds only
control normalized matches and provisional component proposals; rejected HSPs
are never silently deleted. Exact values and input checksums are recorded in
`manifest.json`.
